containers.name: readout
args:
set -euo pipefail
export KERAS_BACKEND=tensorflow MPLBACKEND=Agg TF_CPP_MIN_LOG_LEVEL=2
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=2 TF_NUM_INTRAOP_THREADS=2 TF_NUM_INTEROP_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1
mkdir -p /work/code
echo '42abed4b5d2e3e9197d36a5031754cfde342fc7b0d03f7bb0106ce16c2e258c0  /cmcode/hgq2.tar.gz' | sha256sum -c -
tar -xzf /cmcode/hgq2.tar.gz -C /work/code --strip-components=1
export PYTHONPATH=/work/code
export BNJ_DATA_ROOT=/data/chang-n64-20260926 BNJ_RUN_ROOT=/data/chang-n64-20260926/pilot-b BNJ_CAMPAIGN_DIR=/work/code/campaigns/chang0926
export BNJ_STAGE=pilot-b
export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=-1 WANDB_MODE=disabled
pip install -q --no-cache-dir -r /work/code/requirements-cpu.txt
cd /work/code
MSHA=$(python -c "import run_study; print(run_study.manifest()['sha256'])")
test "$MSHA" = "041f981a9d5b8c3a7affb175d82de0ca2df9bc6261a172f67cb365c88b4bbd42" || { echo "MANIFEST_SHA_MISMATCH $MSHA"; exit 1; }
echo "MANIFEST_SHA_OK $MSHA"
export BNHGQ2_CODE_SHA256="$MSHA"
BUNDLE6=42abed
ONLY=""; IDX=""; NSNAP=0; MISSING=""
for pair in 0:chang0926-a-n64-s1 1:chang0926-a-n64-s2 24:chang0926-d-n64-s1 56:chang0926-cprime-n64-s1 57:chang0926-e1-n64-s1; do
  i=${pair%%:*}; n=${pair#*:}; d=/data/chang-n64-20260926/pilot-b/runs/$n
  if test -f "$d/snapshots/epoch-0500/state.json"; then ONLY="$ONLY${ONLY:+,}$n"; IDX="$IDX $i"; NSNAP=$((NSNAP + 1))
  elif test -f "$d/DIVERGED.json"; then ONLY="$ONLY${ONLY:+,}$n"; IDX="$IDX $i"
  else
    why=NO_TERMINAL_MARKER
    test -f "$d/RSS_GATE_FAIL.json" && why=RSS_GATE_FAIL
    echo "READOUT_MISSING $n $why"; MISSING="$MISSING $n"
  fi
done
test "$NSNAP" -gt 0 || { echo "READOUT_NOTHING_PRESENT"; exit 1; }
test -f /data/chang-n64-20260926/n64/data/READY.json || { echo "CACHE_NOT_READY"; exit 1; }
OUT=/data/chang-n64-20260926/pilot-b/readout-epoch-0500-$BUNDLE6-b5
if [ -n "$MISSING" ]; then OUT="$OUT-partial-$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)"; fi
echo "READOUT_ARMS only=$ONLY indices=$IDX missing=${MISSING:- none}"
mkdir -p "$OUT"
CERT=0; A26=0
python -u /work/code/campaigns/chang0926/certify_ebops.py --run-root /data/chang-n64-20260926/pilot-b/runs --cache /data/chang-n64-20260926/n64/data --out "$OUT/certify-snapshot-0500.json" --snapshot 500 --only "$ONLY" || CERT=$?
python -u /work/code/analysis/attn_entropy.py --indices $IDX --epoch 500 --out "$OUT/a26-entropy-epoch-0500.json" || A26=$?
sha256sum "$OUT"/*.json
echo "READOUT_JOB_DONE certify_exit=$CERT a26_exit=$A26 missing=${MISSING:- none}"
test "$CERT" = 0 && test "$A26" = 0
